rationale: Builds on the 9x512 recurrent-tail winner with a new shared-heavy/unique-light depth move instead of another small hyperparameter sweep. The first decoder block is reused once at the encoder-decoder bridge through a zero-init gate, so the run starts near the current best while giving training a cheap way to learn extra effective depth with almost no byte cost and no eval/export path changes beyond a tiny FP32 control scalar.
title: Gated Shared Bridge Recurrence On Recurrent-Tail Best
